Welcome To The Redway School
Redway is an extra special school within Milton Keynes
The Redway School is maintained by Milton Keynes LA (Local Authority) catering for children between the ages of 2 – 19 with a wide range of learning difficulties, including complex medical conditions, profound and multiple learning difficulties, severe learning difficulties.
Welcome to our school
It is a pleasure to welcome you to our school website. The Redway School is an ‘extra special, special school’ in Milton Keynes. We are a generic special school catering for pupils aged between 2 – 19 years of age, with profound and multiple learning difficulties, complex medical conditions, severe learning difficulties.
The Redway School has a positive, safe and caring environment where all pupils are given opportunities to meet their full potential. We aim to make a difference in pupils’ learning, well-being, and their future life opportunities, taking into consideration the full holistic needs of each individual.
Our greatest resource is our staff. The team of highly skilled practitioners work with children in small groups with a high ratio of adults to children using bespoke interventions and strategies to ensure that learning is both accessible and meaningful. Staff strive to meet the individual needs of every pupil. We believe we can unlock each child’s potential, support progress and achievement and ensure all pupils become as independent as possible.
Together with our pupils, families, and other stakeholders, we work closely to achieve the best outcomes for all our pupils.
If after browsing through our website you feel that The Redway School could be an appropriate setting for your child, please do get in contact as we would be delighted to show you around and discuss this further.
Our motto is ‘Belong, Believe, Become’ and everyone within our unique community of The Redway School is proud to see how this is a true reflection of our offer.

Why is Parent Partnership important?
We believe that education is a collaborative enterprise involving parent / carers, staff, children, governors, the Local Authority and a range of other agencies. We are committed to establishing and maintaining an effective and purposeful working relationship between home and school. This is important in enabling all to achieve their full potential.
We aim to...
Have a strong partnership with all parents / carers.
Ensure that all communication with parents / carers is effective, clear and jargon free.
Actively involve parents / carers in the education and progress of their child.
Establish, and act upon, the views and opinions of parents / carers.
Support Group
We also have a parents / carers support group which meets on a regular basis. Information regarding this, together with training and support for parents / carers is sent home once dates and information have been confirmed at the start of each term.
Should you wish for any further information regarding our partnership with parents please email parents@theredway.net

We Believe In Forming Strong Partnerships
We strive to forge strong partnerships and maintain good communication with parents/carers, informing them clearly and promptly about what is happening in school.

A message from the Chair of Governors
Welcome to the section of the website where you can find out more about the Governors and the work that we do to support the school.
The Governing Body is required to meet up at least once each term but in reality, we meet up as a full Governing Body or as smaller groups much more frequently.
We each appreciate the outstanding work that is being done throughout the school, by both pupils and staff, and feel privileged to be involved in such an amazing school.
We work well and efficiently as a team with an emphasis on openness fully supporting the mission statement and ethos of the school. We also work together and provide challenge to the Headteacher, and the strategic Leadership Team to set and reach targets to strive for excellence across the whole spectrum of school life.
Should you be interested in becoming a Governor and supporting the work of the school please do not hesitate to contact by email at info@theredway.net or telephone 01908 200000.
